pre-commit.description: Renovate's pre-commit manager is opt-in, so .pre-commit-config.yaml was unmanaged and its hook pins drifted silently while cargo, dockerfile and github-actions stayed current.

packageRules.description: Never bump the release build image's base. src/.devcontainer/build/Dockerfile pins debian:bullseye because its glibc 2.31 sets the floor of the shipped binary, so a newer base is a regression rather than an update: PR #488 moved it to trixie and broke Rocky 9, Ubuntu 22.04 and Debian 12. Scoped to the docker datasource so it freezes the base image only -- the cargo tool pins in that same file are managed by the customManagers entry below, and must track the dev image. The dev/test image in src/.devcontainer/Dockerfile is not covered by this rule and stays managed.
Automatically merge minor and patch-level updates
Group micropb and micropb-gen: released in lockstep from the same upstream repo and must be bumped together.

Group rust-vmm crates: virtio-queue is built on vm-memory, kvm-ioctls re-exports types from kvm-bindings, and vmm-sys-util is a shared substrate. Major bumps from the rust-vmm org typically land together and fail to compile individually.
Group RustCrypto hash/MAC/KDF crates: sha1, sha2, hmac, and pbkdf2 share the digest and crypto-common trait crates and must be major-bumped together to keep trait versions consistent.
Group RustCrypto cipher crates: aes and xts-mode share the cipher trait crate, so major bumps must land together to keep trait versions consistent.

customManagers.description: Bump the pinned `cargo install` tool versions in both devcontainer images. These tools are installed from crates.io rather than declared in a Cargo.toml, so no built-in manager sees them and they floated to the newest release on every from-scratch image build until they were pinned. Matching them here brings them under the repo-wide minimumReleaseAge, and because Renovate raises one PR per crate across all matching files, the shared pins in the dev and build images move together.
